title: CHASE: Cache-Hole-Adapted Skip Exit for Looped State-Space Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.10110v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work on looped language models suggests that many reasoning problems benefit from greater computational depth rather than from additional independent parameters. Existing studies, however, focus almost exclusively on Transformer backbones, leaving open whether this principle also applies to state-space language models. We investigate Looped Mamba and Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures, which repeatedly apply a shared Mamba (or hybrid) block to introduce explicit finite-depth recurrent computation. On two controlled reasoning tasks-Mano (modular-arithmetic manipulation) and p-hop induction-Looped Mamba consistently outperforms parameter-matched non-looped baselines and, in several settings, matches or exceeds non-looped models of equal effective depth. We then extend the study to language model pre-training under matched iso-parameter and iso-FLOPs protocols, which jointly disentangle the effects of parameter sharing

translated_title: CHASE：面向循环状态空间语言模型的缓存空洞自适应跳过退出机制
translated_abstract: 关于循环语言模型的最新研究表明，许多推理问题受益于更大的计算深度，而非额外增加的独立参数。然而，现有研究几乎完全聚焦于Transformer骨干网络，这一原则是否同样适用于状态空间语言模型仍是未解之题。我们研究了循环Mamba和循环混合Mamba-Transformer架构，它们通过反复应用共享的Mamba（或混合）模块来引入显式的有限深度循环计算。在两个受控推理任务——Mano（模运算操纵）和p跳归纳——上，循环Mamba始终优于参数量匹配的非循环基线模型，并且在若干设置下达到或超过了同等有效深度的非循环模型。随后，我们将研究扩展到等参数量和等FLOPs协议下的语言模型预训练，以共同厘清参数共享所带来的影响。
tldr: 本文首次将循环架构范式从Transformer扩展到状态空间语言模型，提出循环Mamba架构及缓存空洞自适应跳过退出机制（CHASE），证明共享参数的循环计算能在推理任务上超越参数量匹配的非循环基线，并在等参数、等计算量条件下实现媲美非循环模型的预训练性能。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the looped architecture paradigm from Transformers to state-space language models, proposing Looped Mamba with a Cache-Hole-Adapted Skip Exit (CHASE) mechanism, showing that looping with shared parameters outperforms parameter-matched non-looped baselines on reasoning tasks and matches non-looped models in pre-training under iso-parameter and iso-FLOPs protocols.
